run_bleu_scoring_corpus: run BLEU scoring of generated translations against reference translations using fairseq
run_bleu_scoring_sacrebleu: run BLEU scoring with sacrebleu by passing the --sacrebleu flag to the scorer
run_bleu_scoring_sentence_level: run sentence-level BLEU scoring with +1 smoothing using the --sentence-bleu flag
run_bleu_scoring_case_insensitive: run case-insensitive BLEU scoring by passing the --ignore-case flag to the scorer
run_bleu_scoring_custom_ngram_order: run BLEU scoring considering ngrams up to a custom order using the -o flag
